ingredients:
800g Pork belly slices
1.5 tbsp Coarse salt
1kg Potatoes
50g Butter
50g Flour
500ml Whole milk
1 cup Fresh parsley
instructions:
1.    Season pork belly slices generously with sea salt on all sides.
2.    Roast in oven at 200°C for 35 minutes until crispy and golden.
3.    Boil peeled potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
4.    Prepare a roux with butter and flour, then whisk in milk until smooth.
5.    Stir in chopped parsley and serve over crispy pork and potatoes.
title: Stegt Flæsk med Persillesovs

ingredients:
4 slices Dark rye bread (rugbrød)
50g Salted butter
200g Cold-smoked salmon
4 tbsp Scrambled eggs
Fresh dill & lemon
instructions:
1.    Butter rye bread slices generously to the edges.
2.    Lay smoked salmon ribbons neatly across the bread.
3.    Top with warm scrambled eggs.
4.    Garnish with fresh dill sprigs and lemon wedges.
title: Smørrebrød med Hjemmelavet Røget Laks

ingredients:
500g Minced pork
1 Onion, grated
1 Egg
4 tbsp Flour
1L Broth
2 tbsp Curry powder
40g Butter
300g Basmati rice
instructions:
1.    Combine minced pork, onion, egg, flour, salt, and pepper into smooth meatballs.
2.    Poach meatballs in simmering broth for 12 minutes until cooked.
3.    Toast curry powder in melted butter, then whisk in flour and broth to thicken.
4.    Simmer meatballs in curry sauce and serve with rice.
title: Boller i Karry

ingredients:
1.2kg Beef shank
2 Leeks
4 Carrots
1/2 Celeriac
2 Bay leaves
200g Danish soup dumplings
instructions:
1.    Cover beef shank with cold water and bring to a boil in a stockpot.
2.    Skim off foam, add vegetables and bay leaves, and simmer for 2 hours.
3.    Strain clear broth and slice cooked beef into bite-sized pieces.
4.    Poach dumplings in clear broth for 5 minutes before serving.
title: Gammeldags Oksekødssuppe

ingredients:
1 Whole cooked chicken, shredded
12 Puff pastry tartelet shells
400g White asparagus
50g Butter
50g Flour
200ml Cream
instructions:
1.    Make a white sauce with butter, flour, chicken broth, and cream.
2.    Fold shredded chicken and white asparagus into the sauce.
3.    Bake tartelet shells at 180°C for 5 minutes until warm and crispy.
4.    Fill warm shells with chicken mixture and serve immediately.
title: Tarteletter med Høns i Asparges

ingredients:
4 Plaice fillets
100g Flour
2 Eggs, beaten
150g Breadcrumbs
75g Butter
150g Danish remoulade
Lemon
instructions:
1.    Dredge fish fillets in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs.
2.    Fry in butter over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden.
3.    Drain on paper towels and serve with remoulade and fresh lemon.
title: Pan-Fried Fiskefileter med Remoulade

ingredients:
500g Ground beef
2 Onions, diced
400ml Beef stock
2 tbsp Gravy browning
1kg Mashed potatoes
instructions:
1.    Sauté diced onions in oil until translucent.
2.    Brown ground beef while breaking it into fine pieces.
3.    Pour in beef stock and browning sauce, simmering for 15 minutes.
4.    Thicken with cornstarch slurry and serve over warm mashed potatoes.
title: Millionbøf med Kartoffelmos

ingredients:
1kg Potatoes
75g Butter
150ml Milk
300g Smoked bacon lardons
3 Onions, diced
Pickled beetroots
instructions:
1.    Boil potatoes and mash with butter and warm milk until smooth.
2.    Fry bacon lardons until crispy, then cook onions in bacon fat until soft.
3.    Spoon mashed potatoes onto plates and top with bacon and caramelized onions.
4.    Serve with pickled beetroot slices on the side.
title: Brændende Kærlighed

ingredients:
600g Ground beef
4 Onions, sliced
50g Butter
250ml Beef stock
Gravy browning
Boiled potatoes
instructions:
1.    Shape ground beef into 4 thick patties and season with salt and pepper.
2.    Slow-cook onion rings in butter for 15 minutes until golden and sweet.
3.    Sear patties for 4 minutes per side, then reduce stock into gravy.
4.    Top beef patties with onions and serve with potatoes and brown gravy.
title: Hakkebøf med Bløde Løg

ingredients:
2kg Pork roast with rind
2 tbsp Coarse sea salt
1kg Small potatoes
85g Sugar
50g Butter
500ml Red cabbage
instructions:
1.    Score pork rind deeply, rub salt into scores, and roast at 200°C for 75 mins.
2.    Melt sugar in pan, add butter, and roll potatoes until caramelized and shiny.
3.    Carve crispy pork roast and serve with sweet potatoes and warm cabbage.
title: Flæskesteg med Brunede Kartofler

ingredients:
1L Milk
150g Porridge rice
1 Vanilla pod
100g Whole blanched almonds
400ml Heavy cream
300ml Warm cherry sauce
instructions:
1.    Cook rice with milk and vanilla pod into a thick rice pudding, then cool completely.
2.    Chop almonds finely, leaving one whole almond for the tradition.
3.    Whip heavy cream until soft peaks form and fold into cold rice pudding with almonds.
4.    Serve chilled with warm dark cherry sauce poured over top.
title: Risalamande med Kirsebærsauce

ingredients:
500g Mixed red berries (strawberries, raspberries, redcurrants)
150g Sugar
1 Vanilla bean
3 tbsp Potato starch
200ml Heavy cream
instructions:
1.    Simmer berries with sugar, vanilla, and 100ml water for 10 minutes.
2.    Stir in potato starch slurry off heat to thicken into a translucent berry pudding.
3.    Pour into dessert bowls and dust lightly with sugar to prevent skin forming.
4.    Serve cold with heavy cream poured over top.
title: Rødgrød med Fløde

ingredients:
1L Buttermilk
500ml Danish koldskål or thick yogurt
4 Egg yolks
75g Sugar
1 Lemon zest & juice
1 Vanilla bean
Kammerjunkere biscuits
instructions:
1.    Whisk egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and lemon zest together until pale and fluffy.
2.    Whisk in buttermilk and lemon juice until smooth and refreshing.
3.    Chill in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
4.    Serve cold topped with crispy Danish kammerjunkere biscuits.
title: Koldskål med Kammerjunkere

ingredients:
250g Flour
250g Sugar
3 Eggs
50g Butter
150ml Milk
2 tsp Baking powder
TOPPING: 125g Butter, 100g Coconut flakes, 225g Brown sugar, 50ml Milk
instructions:
1.    Whip eggs and sugar until pale; fold in flour, baking powder, melted butter, and milk.
2.    Bake cake batter in a greased pan at 190°C for 20 minutes.
3.    Melt topping ingredients in a saucepan until brown sugar dissolves.
4.    Spread coconut topping over warm cake and bake for 5 more minutes at 220°C until bubbly.
title: Drømmekage fra Brovst

ingredients:
500g Flour
50g Yeast
250ml Milk, warm
75g Butter
2 tbsp Sugar
1 Egg
TOPPING: 150g Butter, 200g Dark brown sugar, 2 tbsp Cinnamon
instructions:
1.    Dissolve yeast in warm milk, mix with flour, butter, egg, and sugar into a soft dough.
2.    Let dough rise for 45 minutes, then press into a baking sheet and make deep dimples.
3.    Melt butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon together and pour over dough.
4.    Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until topping caramelizes into soft wells.
title: Brunsviger

ingredients:
500g Flour
75g Butter
250ml Milk
25g Yeast
1 tsp Cardamom
FILLING: 100g Soft butter, 100g Sugar, 3 tbsp Ground cinnamon
instructions:
1.    Knead dough ingredients into a smooth yeast dough and let rise for 1 hour.
2.    Roll dough into a large rectangle and spread butter, cinnamon, and sugar evenly.
3.    Roll into a log, slice into 12 cinnamon rolls, and place on baking pan.
4.    Bake at 200°C for 12–14 minutes until golden brown.
title: Kanelsnegle

ingredients:
300g All-purpose flour
200g Cold butter, cubed
100g Powdered sugar
1 Egg yolk
150g Raspberry jam
GLAZE: 150g Powdered sugar, 2 tbsp Water, freeze-dried raspberries
instructions:
1.    Rub cold butter into flour and powdered sugar, bind with egg yolk, and chill 30 mins.
2.    Roll out dough into two large rectangles and bake at 190°C for 12 minutes.
3.    Spread raspberry jam over one baked sheet and top with the second sheet.
4.    Spread white icing over top, sprinkle freeze-dried raspberries, and slice into bars.
title: Hindbærsnitter

ingredients:
400g Salted pork belly slices
4 Large tart cooking apples (peeled & cored)
2 Onions, sliced
2 tbsp Sugar
Fresh thyme
instructions:
1.    Fry pork belly slices in a dry skillet until brown and crispy; set aside.
2.    Add sliced onions to pork fat and cook until soft and translucent.
3.    Add apple wedges and sugar to pan, cooking gently until apples soften into a rough compote.
4.    Serve pork slices arranged over warm apple compote with rye bread.
title: Æbleflæsk

ingredients:
800g Fresh cod fillets
1L Water
2 tbsp Salt
1 Bay leaf
50g Butter
50g Flour
3 tbsp Coarse mustard
Hard-boiled eggs & beetroots
instructions:
1.    Bring salted water with bay leaf to a boil, drop cod fillets in, and turn off heat.
2.    Let cod poach covered for 8–10 minutes until opaque and flaky.
3.    Make a white sauce with butter, flour, fish broth, and mustard.
4.    Serve poached cod with mustard sauce, chopped eggs, and pickled beetroots.
title: Kogt Torsk med Sennepssovs

ingredients:
500g White fish fillets (cod or smoked fish)
1 Egg
3 tbsp Flour
100ml Milk
1 Small onion, grated
Butter for frying
instructions:
1.    Pulse fish fillets in food processor with onion, egg, flour, milk, salt, and pepper.
2.    Shape fish mixture into patties using a spoon.
3.    Fry patties in butter over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
4.    Serve warm with classic Danish remoulade sauce and rye bread.
title: Fiskefrikadeller med Remoulade

ingredients:
500g Cooking apples
75g Sugar
1 Vanilla bean
150g Breadcrumbs or macaron crumbs
40g Butter
250ml Heavy cream
instructions:
1.    Simmer peeled apples with sugar and vanilla until soft stewed apples form.
2.    Toast breadcrumbs with butter and sugar in a skillet until crisp and golden.
3.    Layer cold apple compote and toasted crumbs alternately in glass cups.
4.    Top with dollops of whipped heavy cream before serving.
title: Æblekage (Gammeldags)

ingredients:
1L Buttermilk
250ml Vanilla yogurt
3 Egg yolks
60g Powdered sugar
200g Fresh strawberries, sliced
instructions:
1.    Whisk egg yolks and powdered sugar until creamy.
2.    Whisk in buttermilk and vanilla yogurt until thoroughly combined.
3.    Pour into bowls and top generously with fresh sliced strawberries.
title: Kærnemælkskoldskål med Jordbær

ingredients:
500g Flour
250g Cold butter for laminating
25g Yeast
250ml Cold milk
1 Egg
Custard & almond filling
instructions:
1.    Make basic yeast dough and enclose cold butter block inside.
2.    Fold and roll dough 3 times (3x3 turns), chilling 30 mins between folds.
3.    Shape pastries, top with custard or jam, and bake at 210°C for 15 minutes.
title: Wienerbrød (Danish Pastry)

ingredients:
500g Pig liver
350g Pork fat
1 Onion
5 Anchovy fillets
50g Butter
50g Flour
300ml Milk
2 Eggs
instructions:
1.    Grind liver, pork fat, onion, and anchovies together twice in meat grinder.
2.    Make roux with butter, flour, and milk; cool slightly and mix with beaten eggs.
3.    Fold liver mixture into sauce, pour into loaf pan, and bake in water bath at 175°C for 1 hour.
title: Hjemmelavet Leverpostej

ingredients:
6 Danish red sausages (pølser), sliced
600g Boiled potatoes, cubed
1 Onion, diced
2 tbsp Tomato paste
150ml Heavy cream
1 tbsp Paprika
instructions:
1.    Sauté diced onion and sausage slices in butter until browned.
2.    Stir in tomato paste and sweet paprika, cooking for 1 minute.
3.    Add cubed boiled potatoes and heavy cream, simmering for 10 minutes until rich.
title: Svensk Pølseret

ingredients:
600g Minced pork and veal
1 Egg
100g Breadcrumbs
50g Butter
300g Carrots & green peas
300ml White cream sauce
instructions:
1.    Shape meat into 4 round patties, dip in beaten egg, and bread with crumbs.
2.    Fry patties in butter for 5 minutes per side until crisp and cooked through.
3.    Boil carrots and peas, stir into warm white cream sauce, and serve alongside karbonader.
title: Karbonader med Ærter og Gulerødder

ingredients:
800g Minced beef & pork
1 Egg
100g Breadcrumbs
150ml Milk
10 slices Bacon
250ml Game stock
150ml Heavy cream
Redcurrant jelly
instructions:
1.    Mix minced meat, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, salt, and pepper; shape into a loaf.
2.    Wrap loaf in bacon slices and place in a baking dish.
3.    Pour stock into pan and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes, basting frequently.
4.    Strain pan juices, combine with cream and redcurrant jelly to make gravy.
title: Forloren Hare

ingredients:
1 Whole chicken
1 bunch Fresh parsley
50g Butter
300ml Chicken stock
100ml Cream
1 Cucumber, sliced thin
100ml Vinegar & sugar pickle
instructions:
1.    Stuff chicken cavity with parsley and butter; sear outside in a Dutch oven.
2.    Pour in chicken stock and simmer covered for 45 minutes until tender.
3.    Pickle sliced cucumber in vinegar, sugar, and water for 30 minutes.
4.    Thicken chicken broth with cream to make gravy and serve with chicken and cucumber salad.
title: Gammeldags Kylling med Agurkesalat

ingredients:
800g Fresh Danish medister sausage
50g Butter
1 Head white cabbage, shredded
400ml Milk
3 tbsp Flour
Nutmeg
instructions:
1.    Boil medister sausage in water for 10 mins, then pan-fry in butter until golden.
2.    Boil shredded cabbage in salted water for 15 mins; drain thoroughly.
3.    Make white sauce with butter, flour, and milk; season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
4.    Fold cooked cabbage into white sauce and serve with fried medister sausage.
title: Medisterpølse med Stuvet Hvidkål

ingredients:
4 slices Dark rye bread
4 Smoked herring fillets
4 Fresh raw egg yolks
Chopped chives
Radishes, sliced
Raw red onion
instructions:
1.    Butter dark rye bread slices.
2.    Place smoked herring fillet on each slice of bread.
3.    Top fillet with sliced radishes and diced red onion.
4.    Carefully place raw egg yolk in an onion ring on top and sprinkle with chives.
title: Sol over Gudhjem

ingredients:
300g Cooked chicken breast, cubed
150g Mayonnaise
3 tbsp Sour cream
100g Canned asparagus pieces
100g Bacon, fried crisp
White toast bread
instructions:
1.    Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, salt, pepper, and a drop of lemon juice.
2.    Fold cubed cooked chicken and asparagus pieces into mayo dressing.
3.    Toast white bread slices until golden brown.
4.    Heap chicken salad onto toast and top with crispy bacon strips.
title: Hønsesalat på Toast

ingredients:
400g Flour
25g Yeast
200ml Milk
50g Butter
REMONCE: 100g Butter, 100g Sugar, 2 tbsp Cinnamon
Custard filling
instructions:
1.    Roll out rich yeast dough into a long rectangle.
2.    Spread cinnamon remonce butter and vanilla pastry cream down the center.
3.    Fold edges over, let rise 30 mins, and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
title: Kanelstang med Remonce

ingredients:
500g Flour
150g Butter
200ml Milk
25g Yeast
2 Eggs
Vanilla pastry cream
Chocolate glaze
instructions:
1.    Roll out yeast dough and cut into 12 squares.
2.    Place a spoon of vanilla pastry cream in the center of each square.
3.    Fold corners together, seal edges tightly, and place seam-down on baking sheet.
4.    Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, cool, and top with dark chocolate icing.
title: Fastelavnsboller med Vaniljecreme

ingredients:
500g Raw almond paste (marcipan)
150g Powdered sugar
2 Egg whites
ROYAL ICING: 150g Powdered sugar, 1 egg white
instructions:
1.    Knead almond paste, powdered sugar, and egg whites into a firm dough.
2.    Roll into ropes and cut into graduating ring lengths.
3.    Bake rings at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until light golden brown.
4.    Stack rings into a pyramid, piping white royal icing zig-zags between layers.
title: Kransekage

ingredients:
PASTRY: 200g Flour, 100g Butter, 50g Sugar
MAZARIN: 150g Almond paste, 100g Butter, 100g Sugar, 2 Eggs
500g Fresh strawberries
Vanilla cream
instructions:
1.    Line tart pan with pastry dough and spread almond mazarin filling inside.
2.    Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until golden, then cool completely.
3.    Brush baked tart base with melted dark chocolate.
4.    Spread vanilla custard cream over chocolate and cover with fresh halved strawberries.
title: Jordbærtærte med Mazarin

ingredients:
400g Flour
100g Butter
150ml Milk
25g Yeast
Remonce filling (butter, marzipan, sugar)
instructions:
1.    Knead butter, milk, yeast, and flour into soft dough.
2.    Fill dough squares with marzipan remonce butter.
3.    Bake at 190°C for 15 minutes and glaze with sugar icing.
title: Gammeldags Fastelavnsboller med Remonce

ingredients:
200g Marzipan
150g Soft butter
150g Sugar
3 Eggs
75g Flour
150g Fresh raspberries
instructions:
1.    Grate marzipan and cream together with butter and sugar until smooth.
2.    Beat in eggs one at a time, then gently fold in flour.
3.    Pour batter into cake pan, press fresh raspberries on top, and bake at 175°C for 35 minutes.
title: Hindbær Mazarinkage

ingredients:
200g Butter
200g Sugar
4 Eggs
200g Flour
1 tsp Baking powder
Zest of 2 Lemons
Yellow lemon icing
instructions:
1.    Beat butter and sugar until fluffy, then add eggs one by one.
2.    Fold in flour, baking powder, and fresh lemon zest.
3.    Bake in half-moon cake tin at 175°C for 30 minutes.
4.    Spread vibrant yellow lemon icing over cold cake.
title: Citronmåne

ingredients:
250g Flour
1 tsp Baking soda
0.5 tsp Cardamom
3 Eggs (separated)
375ml Buttermilk
50g Melted butter
Powdered sugar & jam
instructions:
1.    Whisk flour, baking soda, cardamom, egg yolks, buttermilk, and melted butter.
2.    Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold into batter.
3.    Heat æbleskiver pan, add butter to holes, pour batter, and turn spheres using a wooden skewer.
4.    Serve hot dusted with powdered sugar and dipped in raspberry jam.
title: Æbleskiver

ingredients:
500g Flour
150g Butter
150g Sugar
3 Eggs
1 tsp Cardamom
Zest of 1 Lemon
500g Lard for frying
instructions:
1.    Roll dough out thin, cut into diamond shapes, and slice a slit in the middle.
2.    Twist one end through the center slit to create traditional klejne twist shape.
3.    Fry in hot melted lard at 180°C for 2 minutes until golden brown.
4.    Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
title: Klejner

ingredients:
500g Butter
375g Sugar
2 Vanilla beans
1 Egg
500g Flour
125g Almond flour
instructions:
1.    Cream butter, sugar, and scraped vanilla bean seeds until light.
2.    Mix in egg, flour, and almond flour to form pipeable cookie dough.
3.    Pipe dough through star tip into small wreath circles on baking sheet.
4.    Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until edges turn light golden.
title: Vaniljekranse

ingredients:
500g Ground pork & veal
1 Onion, minced
1 Egg
4 tbsp Flour
150ml Milk
1kg Boiled potatoes
200g Sour cream & mayo salad
instructions:
1.    Mix minced meat, onion, egg, flour, milk, salt, and pepper into smooth mixture.
2.    Fry spoon-shaped meatballs in butter for 5 minutes per side.
3.    Mix cold cubed potatoes with sour cream, mayo, chives, and mustard.
4.    Serve hot frikadeller alongside cold creamy potato salad.
title: Frikadeller med Kartoffelsalat

ingredients:
800g Beef brisket, cubed
1.2kg Potatoes, cubed
3 Onions, diced
2 Bay leaves
10 Whole peppercorns
Butter & chives
instructions:
1.    Place beef cubes, onions, bay leaves, and peppercorns in pot; cover with water.
2.    Simmer covered for 1 hour until meat is tender.
3.    Add cubed potatoes and cook until potatoes break down and thicken the stew.
4.    Stir in butter and serve with fresh chives, rye bread, and pickled beetroots.
title: Hvid Labskovs

ingredients:
400g Dried yellow split peas
800g Salted pork belly & shank
4 Carrots
2 Leeks
1/2 Celeriac
Thyme & marjoram
instructions:
1.    Soak yellow split peas in water overnight.
2.    Boil pork belly and shank in water with herbs for 1.5 hours until tender.
3.    Boil split peas in meat broth until soft, then pass through sieve or blend.
4.    Add diced root vegetables to pea soup and serve hot with sliced salted pork.
title: Gule Ærter med Flæsk

ingredients:
1 Head red cabbage, shredded
50g Duck fat or butter
150ml Redcurrant juice
4 tbsp Vinegar
3 tbsp Sugar
1 Cinnamon stick & 3 cloves
instructions:
1.    Melt fat in large pot and add shredded red cabbage.
2.    Pour in redcurrant juice, vinegar, sugar, cinnamon, and cloves.
3.    Simmer covered over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4.    Adjust sweet and sour balance with sugar and vinegar before serving warm.
title: Rødkål (Danish Red Cabbage)

ingredients:
4 Whole plaice (cleaned)
100g Rye flour
100g Butter
2 tbsp Capers
Fresh lemon wedges
Boiled potatoes
instructions:
1.    Dredge whole plaice fish in coarse rye flour seasoned with salt.
2.    Pan-fry fish in generous butter for 4 minutes per side.
3.    Brown remaining butter in pan until nutty, adding capers.
4.    Spoon browned butter caper sauce over crisp fish and serve with lemon.
title: Stegt Rødspætte med Brunet Smør

ingredients:
800g Potatoes & 200g Carrots
75g Butter
100ml Milk
250g Bacon lardons
2 Onions
instructions:
1.    Boil potatoes and carrots together, then mash with butter and milk.
2.    Fry bacon until crisp and caramelize onions in bacon fat.
3.    Spoon carrot-potato mash onto plates and top with bacon and onions.
title: Brændende Kærlighed med Gulerødder

ingredients:
40g Butter
40g Flour
400ml Whole milk
100ml Potato cooking water
1.5 cups Fresh parsley, chopped
instructions:
1.    Melt butter in saucepan and whisk in flour for 1 minute.
2.    Gradually whisk in milk and potato water until velvety sauce forms.
3.    Simmer 5 minutes, season with salt and white pepper, and stir in chopped parsley.
title: Persillesovs (Classic Parsley Sauce)

ingredients:
500g Yeast dough base
150g Butter
200g Brown sugar
2 tbsp Cinnamon
White sugar glaze icing
instructions:
1.    Prepare rich yeast dough, let rise, and press into baking sheet with deep dimples.
2.    Pour melted brown sugar cinnamon butter over dough.
3.    Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, cool slightly, and drizzle with white icing.
title: Klassisk Brunsviger med Glasur

ingredients:
1 Shortcrust tart shell
150g Marzipan paste
100g Soft butter
2 Eggs
3 Fresh pears, sliced
instructions:
1.    Blend marzipan, butter, and eggs into smooth almond cream.
2.    Spread filling inside tart shell and arrange pear slices in fan pattern.
3.    Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until golden brown.
title: Pæretærte med Marcipan

ingredients:
400g Bomba rice
500g Chicken thighs, cut
400g Rabbit, cut
200g Flat green beans (bajoqueta)
100g Garrofó white beans
1 Tomato, grated
1 pinch Saffron threads
1L Chicken broth
instructions:
1.    Sear chicken and rabbit pieces in extra virgin olive oil until golden brown.
2.    Add green beans and garrofó beans, frying for 5 minutes.
3.    Stir in grated tomato and saffron, then pour in warm broth and bring to boil.
4.    Add Bomba rice evenly, cook on high for 8 minutes, then reduce heat for 10 minutes.
5.    Let stand 5 minutes off heat to develop crisp bottom layer (socarrat).
title: Paella Valenciana Tradicional

ingredients:
800g Yukon gold potatoes, sliced
1 Large yellow onion, sliced
6 Extra large eggs
500ml Extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Sea salt
instructions:
1.    Slow-fry sliced potatoes and onions in olive oil over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until soft.
2.    Drain potatoes and onions, reserving oil for cooking.
3.    Whisk eggs with salt in large bowl, fold in warm potato mixture, and rest 5 minutes.
4.    Heat 2 tbsp oil in non-stick pan, pour mixture, cook 4 minutes, flip using a plate, and cook 3 minutes.
title: Tortilla de Patatas Clásica

ingredients:
1kg Ripe vine tomatoes
1 Green Italian pepper
1 Cucumber, peeled
1 clove Garlic
100ml Extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Sherry vinegar
1 tsp Salt
instructions:
1.    Wash tomatoes, pepper, and cucumber, chopping into large chunks.
2.    Blend vegetables and garlic in high-speed blender until liquefied.
3.    Drizzle in extra virgin olive oil and sherry vinegar while blending to emulsify.
4.    Pass through fine sieve, season with salt, and chill 2 hours before serving.
title: Gazpacho Andaluz Refrescante

ingredients:
150g Jamón Serrano, finely diced
100g Butter
100g Flour
1L Whole milk
1 pinch Nutmeg
2 Eggs & breadcrumbs for coating
instructions:
1.    Melt butter in saucepan, add diced Jamón Serrano, and sauté for 1 minute.
2.    Stir in flour and cook roux for 2 minutes.
3.    Whisk in warm milk gradually until smooth, thick besamel forms; season with nutmeg.
4.    Chill besamel dough 4 hours, shape into cylinders, dredge in flour, egg, breadcrumbs, and fry until golden.
title: Croquetas de Jamón Caseras

ingredients:
600g Potatoes, cut into 2cm cubes
 Olive oil for deep frying
SALSA BRAVA: 2 tbsp Olive oil, 1 tbsp Paprika, 1 tbsp Hot pimentón, 2 tbsp Flour, 250ml Broth
instructions:
1.    Poach potato cubes in olive oil at 140°C for 10 minutes until soft, then remove.
2.    Make brava sauce: sauté paprika and hot pimentón in oil, add flour, then whisk in broth until smooth.
3.    Increase oil temperature to 190°C and double-fry potatoes until extra crispy.
4.    Drain potatoes, sprinkle sea salt, and serve smothered in hot brava sauce.
title: Patatas Bravas con Salsa Picante

ingredients:
1 Whole octopus (approx. 1.5kg)
4 Large potatoes, sliced thick
3 tbsp Extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Sweet & hot pimentón
Coarse sea salt (sal escama)
instructions:
1.    Dip octopus into boiling water 3 times to curl tentacles, then simmer covered for 40 minutes.
2.    Boil potato slices in octopus cooking water until tender.
3.    Slice cooked octopus tentacles into 1cm thick rounds using kitchen shears.
4.    Arrange potato slices on wooden platter, top with octopus, drizzle olive oil, and dust with pimentón and coarse salt.
title: Pulpo a la Gallega

ingredients:
4 Slices rustic sourdough bread
2 Ripe vine tomatoes, halved
1 clove Garlic, peeled
100g Jamón Serrano, thinly sliced
Extra virgin olive oil
instructions:
1.    Toast sourdough bread slices until sturdy and golden brown.
2.    Rub peeled garlic clove over warm toasted bread surface.
3.    Grate cut side of tomato directly onto toast, soaking bread with pulp.
4.    Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil and top with Jamón Serrano.
title: Pan con Tomate y Jamón Serrano

ingredients:
500g Dried Asturian faba beans
2 Asturian chorizo sausages
2 Asturian morcilla (blood sausages)
200g Cured pork belly (lacón)
1 pinch Saffron
instructions:
1.    Soak faba beans in cold water overnight.
2.    Place beans, chorizo, morcilla, and pork belly in pot; cover with cold water.
3.    Bring to boil, skim impurities, add saffron, and simmer gently over low heat for 2 hours.
4.    Add splashes of cold water twice during cooking (asustar las fabas) to prevent skin breaking.
title: Fabada Asturiana

ingredients:
400g Chickpeas, soaked
500g Beef shank
200g Salt pork
2 Chorizos & 2 Morcillas
1/2 Cabbage
4 Potatoes
Soup vermicelli pasta
instructions:
1.    Simmer beef shank, salt pork, and soaked chickpeas in large pot for 2 hours.
2.    Add potatoes, cabbage, chorizo, and morcilla; cook 30 more minutes.
3.    Strain broth into separate pot and cook vermicelli pasta to serve as first course (sopa).
4.    Serve chickpeas, vegetables, and meats as second course (vuelco).
title: Cocido Madrileño

ingredients:
2 Zucchini, cubed
1 Red bell pepper & 1 green pepper
1 Onion, diced
400g Grated tomatoes
4 Eggs
Extra virgin olive oil
instructions:
1.    Sauté diced onions and peppers in olive oil over medium heat for 15 minutes.
2.    Add zucchini cubes and cook 10 minutes until soft.
3.    Stir in grated tomatoes, salt, and sugar; simmer 15 minutes until thick stew forms.
4.    Fry eggs in olive oil until edges are crispy and serve over warm pisto.
title: Pisto Manchego con Huevo

ingredients:
1kg Ripe plum tomatoes
200g Stale white bread
150ml Extra virgin olive oil
1 clove Garlic
Hard-boiled egg & diced Jamón for garnish
instructions:
1.    Soak stale bread cubes in tomato pulp for 10 minutes.
2.    Blend tomatoes, bread, and garlic until completely smooth.
3.    Slowly stream in olive oil while blending continuously to create creamy emulsion.
4.    Chill 2 hours, season with salt, and serve topped with chopped egg and jamón.
title: Salmorejo Cordobés

ingredients:
400g Large raw shrimp, peeled
8 cloves Garlic, sliced thin
1 Dried red cayenne chili
100ml Extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped
instructions:
1.    Heat olive oil in clay cazuela pan over medium heat with garlic and chili.
2.    Cook garlic until light golden brown.
3.    Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
4.    Remove from heat, sprinkle fresh parsley, and serve sizzling with crusty bread.
title: Gambas al Ajillo

ingredients:
500g Fresh squid rings
100g Flour
1 tsp Baking powder
1 Egg
100ml Cold sparkling water
Olive oil for frying
Lemon
instructions:
1.    Whisk flour, baking powder, egg, and cold sparkling water into light batter.
2.    Pat squid rings dry and season with salt.
3.    Dip rings in batter and deep-fry in hot oil at 180°C for 2 minutes until crisp.
4.    Drain on paper towels and serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges.
title: Calamares a la Romana

ingredients:
500g Minced beef & pork
1 Egg
50g Breadcrumbs
1 Onion & 2 Garlic cloves
100ml White broth
1 tbsp Flour
100ml Tomato puree
instructions:
1.    Mix minced meat, egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic, salt, and parsley into meatballs.
2.    Dredge meatballs in flour and fry in olive oil until browned; set aside.
3.    Sauté diced onion in pan fat, add flour, tomato puree, and broth to make sauce.
4.    Simmer meatballs in Spanish sauce for 20 minutes until tender.
title: Albóndigas en Salsa Española

ingredients:
4 Salt cod fillets (desalted)
6 cloves Garlic, sliced
1 Dried chili pepper
250ml Extra virgin olive oil
instructions:
1.    Fry garlic slices and chili in olive oil over low heat until golden; remove garlic.
2.    Place cod fillets skin-side down in warm oil and cook low for 10 minutes.
3.    Swirl clay cazuela pan continuously in circular motion off heat to emulsify cod gelatin and oil into thick pale sauce.
4.    Serve cod skin-side up smothered in velvety pil-pil emulsion and topped with garlic.
title: Bacalao al Pil-Pil

ingredients:
400g Fideuà short pasta (No. 2)
400g Monkfish or cuttlefish, cubed
300g Raw prawns
1 Tomato, grated
1 tbsp Sweet paprika
1L Fish stock (fumet)
Alioli for serving
instructions:
1.    Toast fideuà pasta in dry pan with olive oil until golden brown; set aside.
2.    Sauté monkfish and prawns in wide paella pan, remove prawns.
3.    Add grated tomato, paprika, and fish stock to pan, bringing to boil.
4.    Add toasted pasta and cook 10 minutes until liquid absorbs and pasta ends curl up.
title: Fideuà de Gandía

ingredients:
400g Bomba rice
400g Cuttlefish (sepia), cubed
4 Squid ink sachets
1 Onion & 2 Garlic cloves
1L Fish stock
Alioli sauce
instructions:
1.    Sauté cuttlefish cubes in paella pan until golden.
2.    Add diced onion and garlic, cooking until soft.
3.    Dissolve squid ink in warm fish stock.
4.    Add rice to pan, stir 2 minutes, pour black stock, cook 18 minutes, and serve with alioli.
title: Arroz Negro con Sepia

ingredients:
400g Cooked chickpeas
300g Fresh spinach
2 Slices white bread
4 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Cumin & 1 tbsp Paprika
2 tbsp Sherry vinegar
instructions:
1.    Fry bread slices and garlic cloves in olive oil until golden brown.
2.    Pound fried bread, garlic, cumin, and paprika in mortar with vinegar to make paste.
3.    Wilt spinach in pan, stir in cooked chickpeas and spice paste.
4.    Simmer 10 minutes until fragrant and serve hot with fried bread croutons.
title: Espinacas con Garbanzos

ingredients:
1.5kg Oxtail pieces
2 Onions, 2 Carrots, 1 Leek
4 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Tomato paste
500ml Meat stock
Thyme & bay leaves
instructions:
1.    Dredge oxtail pieces in flour and sear in olive oil until deeply browned.
2.    Remove meat and sauté chopped onions, carrots, leeks, and garlic in pan.
3.    Return oxtail, add tomato paste, meat stock, and herbs.
4.    Cover and braise low for 3 hours until oxtail meat falls off the bone.
title: Rabo de Toro Estofado

ingredients:
1 Whole chicken, cut into small pieces
12 cloves Garlic, skin-on & crushed
1 Bay leaf
100ml Chicken broth
100ml Olive oil
Fresh parsley
instructions:
1.    Season chicken pieces with sea salt and black pepper.
2.    Heat olive oil in pan and fry crushed garlic cloves over low heat for 5 minutes.
3.    Raise heat, add chicken and bay leaf, and fry until golden and crispy.
4.    Pour in chicken broth to deglaze pan, simmer 10 minutes, and garnish with parsley.
title: Pollo al Ajillo Tradicional

ingredients:
250g Almond flour
250g Sugar
4 Large eggs
Zest of 1 Lemon
1/2 tsp Cinnamon
Powdered sugar for stenciling
instructions:
1.    Whisk eggs and sugar together until pale and thick.
2.    Fold in almond flour, fresh lemon zest, and ground cinnamon until smooth batter forms.
3.    Pour batter into greased round cake pan and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
4.    Cool cake, place St. James cross stencil on top, and dust generously with powdered sugar.
title: Tarta de Santiago

ingredients:
1L Whole milk
6 Egg yolks
200g Sugar
35g Cornstarch
Peel of 1 Lemon & 1 Cinnamon stick
Demerara sugar for torching
instructions:
1.    Infuse milk with lemon peel and cinnamon stick over medium heat for 15 minutes.
2.    Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and cornstarch together in bowl.
3.    Strain warm milk into egg mixture, return to pan, and stir low until thick custard forms.
4.    Pour into clay cazuelitas, chill 3 hours, sprinkle sugar, and caramelize top with blowtorch.
title: Crema Catalana

ingredients:
200g Short-grain rice
1.2L Whole milk
150g Sugar
1 Cinnamon stick & Lemon peel
50g Butter
Ground cinnamon
instructions:
1.    Boil rice in 200ml water for 5 minutes until water absorbs.
2.    Pour in milk, cinnamon stick, and lemon peel, simmering low for 35 minutes while stirring.
3.    Stir in sugar and butter, cook 5 more minutes until velvety.
4.    Pour into dishes, remove cinnamon and lemon peel, and dust top with ground cinnamon.
title: Arroz con Leche Cremoso

ingredients:
1 Stale brioche or torrija bread loaf, sliced
750ml Whole milk infused with cinnamon & lemon peel
3 Eggs, beaten
Sugar and ground cinnamon for coating
Olive oil for frying
instructions:
1.    Soak thick bread slices in warm infused milk until fully saturated but holding shape.
2.    Dip soaked bread slices carefully into beaten eggs.
3.    Fry in hot olive oil for 2 minutes per side until golden brown.
4.    Drain on paper towels and immediately roll in sugar cinnamon mixture.
title: Torrijas Tradicionales

ingredients:
250g All-purpose flour
250ml Water
1 tsp Salt
1 tbsp Olive oil
Oil for frying
CHOCOLATE: 200g Dark chocolate, 500ml Milk, 1 tbsp Cornstarch
instructions:
1.    Bring water, salt, and 1 tbsp oil to boil; stir in flour all at once until dough ball forms.
2.    Transfer dough to churro press or piping bag with star tip.
3.    Pipe 12cm strips directly into hot oil at 190°C and fry 3 minutes until crisp.
4.    Make chocolate: heat milk with dark chocolate and cornstarch until thick; serve churros warm for dipping.
title: Churros con Chocolate

ingredients:
1L Whole milk
120g Cornstarch
150g Sugar
Lemon peel & Cinnamon stick
Eggs & flour for coating
Oil for frying
instructions:
1.    Whisk cornstarch and sugar into cold milk; infuse with lemon peel and cinnamon while cooking until thick paste forms.
2.    Pour paste into greased square dish to 2cm thickness and chill 4 hours until firm.
3.    Cut into squares, dredge in flour and beaten egg, and fry in hot oil until golden brown.
4.    Roll warm leche frita squares in cinnamon sugar before serving.
title: Leche Frita

ingredients:
500g Flour
100ml Warm water & 100ml Oil from sofrito
25g Yeast
FILLING: 3 Onions, 2 Peppers, 400g Canned tuna, 200g Tomato sauce
instructions:
1.    Sauté onions and peppers in olive oil, stir in tomato sauce and tuna, and drain oil.
2.    Knead flour, yeast, warm water, and reserved sofrito oil into pliable dough.
3.    Roll half dough onto baking sheet, spread tuna filling, and cover with remaining dough sheet.
4.    Seal edges, cut steam hole in center, brush with egg wash, and bake at 200°C for 35 minutes.
title: Empanada Gallega de Atún

ingredients:
400g Fresh Padrón peppers
4 tbsp Extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Flaky sea salt (sal Maldon)
instructions:
1.    Wash Padrón peppers and dry thoroughly with paper towels.
2.    Heat olive oil in wide skillet over high heat until smoking.
3.    Add peppers and cook for 4 minutes, tossing until skins blister and char.
4.    Transfer to plate, sprinkle generously with Maldon sea salt, and serve hot.
title: Pimientos del Padrón Salteados

ingredients:
4 Potatoes, cubed & boiled
2 Carrots, cubed & boiled
200g Canned tuna, drained
100g Cooked green peas
2 Hard-boiled eggs, chopped
250g Mayonnaise
instructions:
1.    Combine cold cooked potato cubes, carrot cubes, and green peas in bowl.
2.    Flake tuna into bowl and fold in chopped hard-boiled eggs.
3.    Add mayonnaise and mix gently until evenly coated.
4.    Chill 1 hour before serving, garnished with red pimiento strips.
title: Ensaladilla Rusa Clásica

ingredients:
800g Fresh clams, soaked
1 Onion, finely diced
2 cloves Garlic, minced
1 tbsp Flour
1 tbsp Paprika
100ml Fish stock
Fresh parsley
instructions:
1.    Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
2.    Stir in flour and paprika, cooking for 1 minute.
3.    Pour in fish stock and bring to boil to form smooth sauce.
4.    Add clams, cover pan, and steam for 5 minutes until all clams pop open; sprinkle parsley.
title: Almejas a la Marinera

ingredients:
500g Fresh tuna (bonito), cubed
1kg Potatoes, broken into chunks
1 Onion & 1 Green pepper
2 Choricero pepper pulp tbsp
750ml Fish stock
instructions:
1.    Sauté chopped onion and green pepper in olive oil until soft.
2.    Add choricero pepper pulp and potato chunks, stirring for 2 minutes.
3.    Pour in fish stock and simmer for 25 minutes until potatoes are tender.
4.    Turn off heat, add fresh tuna cubes, cover pan, and let tuna cook in residual heat for 5 minutes.
title: Marmitako de Bonito

ingredients:
200g Cooked octopus, sliced
200g Cooked prawns, peeled
100g Mussels
1 Red pepper & 1 Green pepper, diced
1 Red onion, diced
Olive oil & sherry vinegar dressing
instructions:
1.    Combine seafood, diced peppers, and red onion in salad bowl.
2.    Whisk extra virgin olive oil, sherry vinegar, salt, and pepper into vinaigrette.
3.    Pour dressing over seafood salad and toss thoroughly.
4.    Chill 1 hour before serving cold.
title: Salpicón de Marisco

ingredients:
4 Eggs
250g Sugar
250ml Olive oil
250g Flour
1 tbsp Baking powder
Zest of 1 Lemon
instructions:
1.    Whip eggs and sugar for 5 minutes until thick and pale.
2.    Stream in olive oil while whipping, then fold in flour, baking powder, and lemon zest.
3.    Rest batter in fridge 30 mins, fill muffin cups 3/4 full, and sprinkle sugar on top.
4.    Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until tall golden crowns form.
title: Magdalenas Caseras

ingredients:
3 Eggs
100g Sugar
100ml Olive oil
350g Flour
1 tbsp Anise seeds & 2 tbsp Anise extract
Oil for frying
instructions:
1.    Whisk eggs, sugar, olive oil, and anise extract together.
2.    Fold in flour and crushed anise seeds to form soft dough.
3.    Shape dough into small ring donuts.
4.    Fry in hot olive oil for 3 minutes until golden, then roll in sugar.
title: Rosquillas de Anís

ingredients:
500g Flour
100ml Olive oil infused with sesame & anise
100ml Water
1 pinch Salt
Oil for frying
200g Warm honey for glaze
instructions:
1.    Heat olive oil with sesame and anise seeds, cool, and mix with flour and water into dough.
2.    Roll dough thin, cut into small squares, and fold opposite corners to center.
3.    Fry pestiños in hot oil until crisp and golden brown.
4.    Dip warm pestiños in warm honey glaze and drain.
title: Pestiños Andaluces con Miel

ingredients:
4 Roasted red bell peppers, peeled & sliced
2 Tomatoes, roasted & peeled
2 Hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1/2 Red onion, sliced thin
1 clove Garlic, minced
Extra virgin olive oil
instructions:
1.    Slice roasted peppers into ribbons and place in salad bowl.
2.    Crush roasted tomatoes with minced garlic, olive oil, and vinegar to make dressing.
3.    Pour tomato dressing over pepper ribbons and toss with sliced red onion.
4.    Top salad with hard-boiled egg slices and serve cold.
title: Zorongollo Extremeño

ingredients:
500g Stale sourdough bread, cubed & dampened
150g Bacon lardons
2 Chorizos, sliced
6 cloves Garlic, skin-on
1 tbsp Sweet paprika
Olive oil
instructions:
1.    Dampen bread cubes with salted water and let sit covered for 2 hours.
2.    Fry bacon, sliced chorizo, and garlic cloves in olive oil until crisp; remove meats.
3.    Add sweet paprika to oil, then add dampened bread cubes.
4.    Stir continuously over medium heat for 20 minutes until bread turns golden and crispy, then stir meats back in.
title: Migas Extremeñas

ingredients:
300g White long-grain rice
4 Eggs
4 Bananas, halved lengthwise
400g Tomato sauce
Olive oil for frying
instructions:
1.    Boil white rice in salted water for 15 minutes, drain, and mold into cups on plates.
2.    Fry bananas in pan with butter until golden and sweet.
3.    Fry eggs in olive oil until edges turn crispy.
4.    Pour warm tomato sauce next to rice mold, top with fried eggs, and serve with fried bananas.
title: Arroz a la Cubana

ingredients:
100g Stale rustic bread, sliced
8 cloves Garlic, sliced
1 tbsp Sweet paprika
100g Diced Jamón Serrano
1L Meat stock
4 Eggs
instructions:
1.    Sauté sliced garlic and diced jamón in olive oil until garlic browns slightly.
2.    Add stale bread slices and toast in oil for 2 minutes.
3.    Stir in sweet paprika, pour in meat stock, and simmer for 15 minutes.
4.    Crack eggs directly into hot soup, cover pot, and poach for 3 minutes until egg whites set.
title: Sopa de Ajo Castellana

ingredients:
1 Large galets pasta (giant shells)
300g Minced beef & pork mixture (pilota)
1 Chicken quarter
200g Pork belly & bone
2 Carrots & 2 Potatoes
1/2 Cabbage
instructions:
1.    Simmer chicken, pork belly, and bones in water for 1.5 hours to make rich broth.
2.    Mix minced meat with garlic and parsley, shape into large oval pelota, and add to broth with vegetables.
3.    Cook 30 minutes, then strain broth into separate pot.
4.    Cook galets shell pasta in strained broth and serve soup first, followed by meats and vegetables.
title: Escudella i Carn d'Olla

ingredients:
4 Salt cod fillets (desalted)
6 Choricero dried peppers (soaked & pulp scraped)
3 Red onions, sliced
2 cloves Garlic
100ml Fish stock
Olive oil
instructions:
1.    Slow-cook sliced red onions and garlic in olive oil for 30 minutes until dark and caramelised.
2.    Stir in choricero pepper pulp and fish stock, simmering 10 minutes, then blend into smooth crimson sauce.
3.    Sear salt cod fillets in pan for 3 minutes per side.
4.    Simmer cod in Vizcaína sauce for 5 minutes before serving.
title: Bacalao a la Vizcaína

ingredients:
400g Salt cod strips (desalted)
100g Flour
1 tsp Saffron or yellow food color
100ml Cold sparkling water
Olive oil for frying
Roasted red pepper strips
instructions:
1.    Whisk flour, saffron, and cold sparkling water into thick batter.
2.    Pat salt cod strips dry with paper towels.
3.    Dip cod strips in yellow batter and fry in hot oil until crispy.
4.    Drain on paper towels and wrap each fried cod strip with a roasted red pepper band.
title: Soldaditos de Pavía

ingredients:
6 Hard-boiled eggs, halved
150g Canned tuna, drained
4 tbsp Mayonnaise
2 tbsp Tomato sauce
Stuffed green olives for garnish
instructions:
1.    Remove hard-boiled egg yolks and place in bowl.
2.    Mash egg yolks with drained tuna, mayonnaise, and tomato sauce until smooth paste forms.
3.    Spoon or pipe tuna filling back into egg white halves.
4.    Top each stuffed egg with a sliced green olive and chill before serving.
title: Huevos Rellenos de Atún

ingredients:
1kg Chicken thighs
100g Raw almonds
2 Slices white bread
3 cloves Garlic
1 Onion, diced
150ml Chicken stock
1 pinch Saffron
instructions:
1.    Sear chicken thighs in olive oil until golden brown; set aside.
2.    Fry almonds, bread slices, and garlic in pan oil, then blend with stock and saffron into almond sauce.
3.    Sauté diced onion in pan, add chicken, and pour almond sauce over top.
4.    Simmer covered for 25 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce is rich.
title: Pollo en Salsa de Almendras

ingredients:
800g Pork or beef shoulder, cubed
1 Onion & 1 Green pepper, diced
3 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Tomato paste
400ml Meat stock
1 tsp Sweet paprika
instructions:
1.    Brown meat cubes in olive oil over high heat; set aside.
2.    Sauté onion, green pepper, and garlic in pan fat until tender.
3.    Stir in paprika, tomato paste, meat stock, and return meat to pan.
4.    Cover and simmer low for 45 minutes until meat is melt-in-your-mouth tender.
title: Carne en Salsa Tradicional

ingredients:
1kg Pork spare ribs, cut
MARINADE: 3 tbsp Sweet paprika, 4 cloves Garlic crushed, 1 tbsp Oregano, 3 tbsp Olive oil, 2 tbsp Vinegar, 1 tsp Salt
instructions:
1.    Mix paprika, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil, vinegar, and salt into marinade paste.
2.    Coat pork ribs thoroughly in marinade and rest 2 hours.
3.    Arrange marinated ribs on baking sheet and roast at 200°C for 40 minutes, flipping halfway.
4.    Serve sizzling with roasted potatoes.
title: Costillas de Cerdo Adobadas

ingredients:
16 Small empanadilla dough disks
200g Canned tuna
2 Hard-boiled eggs, chopped
100g Fried tomato sauce
1 Egg for egg wash
instructions:
1.    Mix drained tuna, chopped hard-boiled eggs, and fried tomato sauce in bowl.
2.    Spoon filling onto center of dough disks.
3.    Fold disks into half-moons and crimp edges tightly with fork tines.
4.    Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden.
title: Empanadillas de Atún y Huevo

ingredients:
1 pot Plain yogurt (125g)
3 pots Flour
2 pots Sugar
1 pot Vegetable oil
3 Eggs
1 tbsp Baking powder
Zest of 1 Lemon
instructions:
1.    Beat eggs and sugar together until pale and fluffy.
2.    Add plain yogurt, oil, and fresh lemon zest, mixing well.
3.    Fold in flour and baking powder using the yogurt pot as measurement unit.
4.    Pour into loaf tin and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
title: Bizcocho de Yogur (3-2-1)

ingredients:
1.5L Whole milk
200g Short-grain rice
150g Sugar
50g Butter
Cinnamon stick & lemon peel
Brown sugar for caramelizing
instructions:
1.    Cook rice in milk with cinnamon and lemon peel low and slow for 45 minutes, stirring continuously.
2.    Stir in sugar and butter until ultra-creamy.
3.    Pour into wide dishes and cool completely.
4.    Sprinkle brown sugar over top and burn with hot iron or torch until crunchy caramel crust forms.
title: Arroz con Leche Asturiano

ingredients:
1kg Cream cheese (room temp)
7 Eggs
400g Sugar
500ml Heavy cream
1 tbsp All-purpose flour
instructions:
1.    Whisk cream cheese and sugar together until smooth.
2.    Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
3.    Pour in heavy cream and flour, whisking into silky smooth batter.
4.    Pour into parchment-lined 26cm springform pan and bake at 210°C for 40 minutes until top is deeply browned and center remains jiggly.
title: Tarta de Queso La Viña (San Sebastián Cheesecake)

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti
200g Guanciale, cubed
4 Fresh egg yolks + 1 whole egg
100g Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
Freshly cracked black pepper
instructions:
1.    Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
2.    Crisp cubed guanciale in a wide skillet over medium heat until golden brown and fat renders.
3.    Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, grated Pecorino Romano, and black pepper together in a bowl.
4.    Transfer hot pasta directly into guanciale pan off heat, stir in egg cheese mixture with starchy pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara

ingredients:
400g Penne pasta
1 Onion, diced
3 cloves Garlic, minced
150g Tomato paste
60ml Heavy cream
100g Parmesan cheese
instructions:
1.    Boil penne pasta in salted water until al dente.
2.    Sauté diced onion and garlic in olive oil until soft and translucent.
3.    Add tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes until darkened.
4.    Stir in heavy cream and simmer 3 minutes until smooth and pink.
5.    Toss pasta with sauce, parmesan cheese, and reserved pasta water.
title: Penne alla Vodka

ingredients:
400g Fresh fettuccine pasta
150g Unsalted butter
150g Parmigiano-Reggiano, finely grated
Salt & black pepper
instructions:
1.    Cook fresh fettuccine in boiling salted water for 3 minutes.
2.    Melt butter in a wide skillet with 100ml pasta cooking water.
3.    Add hot fettuccine to pan, sprinkle grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, and toss vigorously to emulsify.
4.    Season with cracked black pepper and serve immediately.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo Clásico

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti or Tagliatelle
300g Ground beef & 200g Pork
1 Onion, 1 Carrot, 1 Celery stick, diced
2 tbsp Tomato paste
400g Passata
150ml Milk
instructions:
1.    Sauté finely diced onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil for 10 minutes.
2.    Add ground beef and pork, browning thoroughly.
3.    Stir in tomato paste and tomato passata, then simmer covered on low heat for 1.5 hours.
4.    Stir in milk, cook 15 minutes, and serve over fresh al dente pasta with parmesan.
title: Spaghetti Bolognese

ingredients:
12 Lasagna sheets
500g Ragù sauce
500ml Béchamel sauce
200g Mozzarella cheese
100g Parmigiano-Reggiano
instructions:
1.    Prepare rich beef ragù and smooth béchamel sauce.
2.    Layer béchamel, lasagna sheets, ragù, and mozzarella in baking dish.
3.    Repeat layering 4 times, topping final layer with béchamel and parmesan.
4.    Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling, resting 10 minutes before slicing.
title: Lasagna Classica al Forno

ingredients:
400g Rigatoni pasta
150g Guanciale, sliced
400g San Marzano peeled tomatoes
80g Pecorino Romano cheese
1 Red chili pepper
instructions:
1.    Crisp guanciale slices with chili pepper in pan until golden; set half aside.
2.    Add crushed San Marzano tomatoes to pan and simmer 15 minutes.
3.    Boil rigatoni until al dente, drain, and toss in tomato guanciale sauce.
4.    Stir in grated Pecorino Romano and top with remaining crispy guanciale.
title: Rigatoni all'Amatriciana

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti
6 cloves Garlic, sliced thin
1 Red chili pepper, chopped
100ml Extra virgin olive oil
Fresh parsley
instructions:
1.    Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
2.    Gently fry sliced garlic and chopped chili in extra virgin olive oil over low heat until pale golden.
3.    Add hot spaghetti and 50ml pasta water directly to oil.
4.    Toss rapidly until sauce emulsifies and garnish with chopped parsley.
title: Spaghetti aglio, olio e peperoncino

ingredients:
400g Trenette or Linguine
2 cups Fresh Genovese basil leaves
50g Pine nuts
2 cloves Garlic
70g Parmigiano & Pecorino
100ml Olive oil
1 Potato & green beans
instructions:
1.    Pound basil, pine nuts, garlic, cheeses, and olive oil in mortar into vibrant green pesto.
2.    Boil cubed potato and green beans with pasta in salted water.
3.    Drain pasta and vegetables, reserving half cup of water.
4.    Mix cold pesto with pasta, vegetables, and pasta water off heat.
title: Pesto alla Genovese con Trenette

ingredients:
400g Spaghetti
1kg Fresh clams
4 cloves Garlic, minced
1 Red chili
4 tbsp Olive oil
Fresh parsley
instructions:
1.    Soak clams in salted water to purge sand, then drain.
2.    Sauté minced garlic and chili in olive oil in wide covered pan.
3.    Add clams, cover, and cook 4 minutes until all shells pop open.
4.    Toss boiled spaghetti in clam juices and garlic oil, finishing with fresh parsley.
title: Spaghetti alle Vongole

ingredients:
400g Fresh tagliatelle
400g Fresh Porcini mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves Garlic
50g Butter & 2 tbsp Olive oil
Parsley & Parmesan
instructions:
1.    Sauté sliced porcini mushrooms in butter and olive oil with garlic for 8 minutes until golden.
2.    Boil fresh tagliatelle for 3 minutes.
3.    Toss pasta into mushroom pan with pasta cooking water.
4.    Garnish with chopped parsley and grated parmesan cheese.
title: Tagliatelle ai Funghi Porcini

ingredients:
400g Tonnarelli or Spaghetti
200g Pecorino Romano, finely grated
2 tbsp Whole black peppercorns, coarsely crushed
instructions:
1.    Toast crushed black peppercorns in dry skillet until fragrant.
2.    Boil pasta in small amount of water to create extra starchy pasta water.
3.    Whisk grated Pecorino with starchy pasta water into smooth paste.
4.    Combine hot pasta, toasted pepper, and cheese paste off heat, stirring rapidly into glossy sauce.
title: Cacio e Pepe

ingredients:
400g Penne rigate
4 cloves Garlic, minced
2 Red chili peppers, chopped
400g Canned crushed tomatoes
Fresh parsley & olive oil
instructions:
1.    Sauté garlic and red chili peppers in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
2.    Add crushed tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer for 15 minutes.
3.    Boil penne pasta until al dente.
4.    Toss penne into spicy tomato sauce and sprinkle fresh chopped parsley.
title: Penne all'Arrabbiata

ingredients:
400g Linguine
Zest and juice of 2 Lemons
100g Butter
100g Heavy cream
100g Parmesan cheese
instructions:
1.    Melt butter with heavy cream, lemon zest, and lemon juice in skillet.
2.    Boil linguine pasta until al dente.
3.    Toss pasta in warm lemon cream sauce over low heat.
4.    Stir in grated parmesan cheese until silky smooth.
title: Linguine al Limone

ingredients:
600g Potato gnocchi
400g Tomato passata
200g Fresh Mozzarella, cubed
50g Parmesan
Fresh basil
instructions:
1.    Simmer tomato passata with garlic, olive oil, and fresh basil for 15 minutes.
2.    Boil potato gnocchi until they float to the surface, then drain.
3.    Fold gnocchi into tomato sauce and transfer to baking dish.
4.    Top with cubed mozzarella and parmesan, then bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until bubbly.
title: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina

ingredients:
400g Rigatoni or Penne
2 Eggplants, cubed & fried
400g San Marzano tomato sauce
100g Ricotta Salata cheese, grated
Fresh basil
instructions:
1.    Fry eggplant cubes in olive oil until golden brown; drain on paper towels.
2.    Simmer tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 15 minutes.
3.    Boil pasta al dente and toss with tomato sauce and fried eggplant.
4.    Serve topped with grated Ricotta Salata cheese and fresh basil leaves.
title: Pasta alla Norma

ingredients:
600g Chicken breast, cubed
200g Yogurt & tikka spices
1 Can tomato sauce
150ml Heavy cream
1 Onion & garlic
instructions:
1.    Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 30 minutes.
2.    Sear chicken in hot pan until charred.
3.    Sauté onion and garlic, stir in tomato sauce and cream, and simmer chicken for 15 minutes.
title: Chicken Tikka Masala

ingredients:
400g Ground beef (80/20)
4 Brioche burger buns
4 Slices American cheese
Pickles, onions & burger sauce
instructions:
1.    Divide ground beef into 4 round balls.
2.    Smash hard on hot cast-iron griddle until thin with lacy crispy edges.
3.    Top with American cheese slices, stack in toasted brioche buns with pickles and sauce.
title: Classic Beef Smash Burger

ingredients:
1kg Yellow onions, sliced
50g Butter
1L Beef broth
Baguede slices
200g Gruyère cheese
instructions:
1.    Caramelize sliced onions low and slow in butter for 40 minutes until rich mahogany brown.
2.    Pour in beef broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
3.    Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with toasted baguette slice and Gruyère cheese, and broil until golden.
title: French Onion Soup (Soupe à l'Oignon)

ingredients:
500g Chicken thighs
400ml Coconut milk
3 tbsp Thai green curry paste
Bamboo shoots & Thai basil
instructions:
1.    Fry green curry paste in coconut cream until fragrant oil separates.
2.    Add chicken thighs and remaining coconut milk; simmer for 15 minutes.
3.    Add bamboo shoots, fish sauce, and fresh Thai basil leaves.
title: Thai Green Chicken Curry

ingredients:
500g Bread flour
250g Cold butter block
10g Yeast
50g Sugar
1 Egg wash
instructions:
1.    Prepare yeasted dough and enclose cold butter block.
2.    Perform three 3-fold laminations, chilling 30 mins between turns.
3.    Cut triangles, roll into crescents, proof 2 hours, and bake at 200°C for 18 minutes until flaky.
title: Classic French Croissant

ingredients:
300g Ladyfinger biscuits (Savoiardi)
500g Mascarpone cheese
4 Eggs, separated
100g Sugar
300ml Espresso coffee
Cocoa powder
instructions:
1.    Whip egg yolks and sugar until thick, then fold in mascarpone cheese.
2.    Whip egg whites to stiff peaks and gently fold into mascarpone cream.
3.    Dip ladyfingers quickly in cooled espresso and layer in glass dish.
4.    Spread mascarpone cream over ladyfingers, repeat layers, and dust top with cocoa powder.
